reviewNotes: Reviewed all 16 cards and 62 speech keys against data/pages76.json source vocabulary and furigana. Verified 肩甲骨 けんこうこつ, 腰椎 ようつい, 横隔膜 おうかくまく, 後脚 こうきゃく, 前脚 ぜんきゃく, 結合組織 けつごうそしき, 外側上部 そとがわじょうぶ and all cut names. Converted katakana cut names to hiragana, preserving long vowels in ろーす and さーろいん. Contextual topic は→わ and object を→お reviewed; no directional へ present. Preserved lexical はらみ and はらがわ. Questions and complete explanations use Nova generation speed 1.0; standalone cut names and short vocabulary-choice groups use 0.85. Display labels and distinct lookup keys preserved. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
